steps.name: Client Request
steps.detail: The client approaches the bank (or the RM identifies a need) with a specific financing requirement.

steps.name: Call Report & Document Collection
steps.detail: The RM meets the client, prepares a call report, and collects the KYC and credit documents needed for analysis.

steps.name: Credit Analysis & Risk Rating
steps.detail: Credit analysis of the financials — ratios, cash flow, working capital cycle — and assignment of an internal risk rating.

steps.name: Credit Committee Approval
steps.detail: The credit proposal is presented to the appropriate approval authority / credit committee. No commitment to the client before this.

steps.name: Offer Letter & Facility Documentation
steps.detail: The approved terms are issued in an offer letter; facility agreements are signed by authorised signatories.

steps.name: Security Perfection
steps.detail: Collateral is put in place and legally perfected — mortgage registered, cash margin blocked, assignments notified — before any utilisation.

steps.name: Limit Setup in System
steps.detail: Operations sets up the approved limits in the core system, checked against the approval and completed documentation.

steps.name: Utilization
steps.detail: The client draws on the facility — cash drawdown, LC issuance, or LG issuance — within the approved limits and conditions.

steps.name: Monitoring & Renewal
steps.detail: Ongoing monitoring: account conduct, covenant checks, periodic financials, site visits, and annual review/renewal.

base: KYC file & Civil IDs of signatories
capex: Supplier quotation / pro-forma for the asset
Cash flow projections covering the loan tenor
recv: Copies of invoices to be discounted
